title.en: Sales Forecasting with Time Series Feature Engineering
title.es: Predicción de Ventas con Feature Engineering de Series de Tiempo

description.en: Decompose your company's pre-included sales CSV in `data/raw/` into trend/seasonality/residual, engineer causal lag, rolling, and calendar features, then train and honestly evaluate a forecasting model (XGBoost or Random Forest): split the first 8 years for training and the 2 most recent for testing with no data leakage, justify the algorithm choice, report MSE, PSI, Gini and K2 Score on the test set, and deliver a visualization showing the forecast with its variability range.
description.es: Descompón el CSV de ventas ya incluido en `data/raw/` de tu monorepo en tendencia/estacionalidad/residual, construye features causales de lag, rolling y calendario, y entrena y evalúa con honestidad un modelo de pronóstico (XGBoost o Random Forest): usa los primeros 8 años para entrenar y los 2 más recientes para prueba sin fuga de datos, justifica la elección del algoritmo, reporta MSE, PSI, Gini y K2 Score sobre el conjunto de prueba, y entrega una visualización que muestre el pronóstico con su rango de variabilidad.

sharing.en: I just completed Sales Forecasting with Time Series Feature Engineering with LearnPack @4GeeksAcademy. Decomposed the series into trend/seasonality/residual, engineered causal lag and rolling features, and trained and honestly evaluated an XGBoost/Random Forest forecaster with an 8-year/2-year split, no data leakage, and a prediction-with-variability visualization.
